details: For every finite binary class and every $0<\epsilon<1/2$, $\mathrm{LR}(\mathcal H,\epsilon)\geq1+\lfloor\mathrm{VC}^{*a}(\mathcal H)/2\rfloor$. Hence $\mathrm{LR}(\mathcal H)\geq\tfrac12\mathrm{VC}^{*a}(\mathcal H)+\tfrac12$.
proof: This is the dual-antipodal-VC consequence stated in Theorem 10. For an integer $d$, $1+\lfloor d/2\rfloor\geq d/2+1/2$; taking the accuracy limit yields the displayed affine bound.
name: List Replicability / Dual Antipodal VC Dimension (affine)
